question.prompt: Point $P$ lies on the perpendicular bisector of segment $AB$. Given $PA=2x+1$ and $PB=3x-4$, find the value of $x$.

solutions.explanation: A point on the perpendicular bisector is equidistant from the two endpoints, so $2x+1=3x-4$. Solving gives $x=5$ (at which point $PA=PB=11$).
solutions.title: Equate the endpoint distances
